description: This file defines the `FileOpenerIterDataPipe`, a data processing class for opening files based on pathnames provided by another iterable data pipe, within the PyTorch DataPipes framework. It includes initialization, validation, iteration to open files, and length handling.

classes.name: FileOpenerIterDataPipe
classes.description: A data pipeline class that opens files from provided pathnames, yielding filename and corresponding file stream tuples.

methods.name: None __init__( self, datapipe: Iterable[str], mode: str = "r", encoding: str | None = None, length: int = -1, )
methods.description: Initializes the data pipe with pathnames iterable, mode, encoding, and length, including mode validation and binary mode encoding checks.

methods.name: Iterator[tuple[str,IOBase]] __iter__(self)
methods.description: Yields tuples of filename and opened file stream for each pathname in the datapipe.

methods.name: int __len__(self)
methods.description: Returns the length of the data pipe if defined; raises an error if length is not specified.
